findings.A2_REAL_TARGET_SHAPE: Predecessor failed on top-level reserved metadata envelope (version, updated, system) with SOURCE_STATE_INVALID/SUBTYPE_UNSUPPORTED_NONEMPTY and zero parsed contracts. Corrected with RESERVED_DOMAIN_CONTRACT_METADATA_KEYS envelope validation, parsing all 4 domain contracts cleanly.
findings.A2_SECTION_IDENTITY: Predecessor collapsed contract content into flat rules, losing section names. Corrected by preserving sections dictionary with named lists and item dicts, proving critical_constraints != review_checklist.
findings.A2_RULE_DICT_TEXT: Predecessor looked only for description/id in dict rules, dropping rule: '...' text. Corrected by extracting rule, text, description, id, name, model and preserving bounded fields (invariant, rationale, field, expected_value).
findings.A3_OWNER_FOCAL_RELATIONS: Exercised genuine owner relations: auth_admin -> security + auth_admin, backend_schema_contract -> response_model_rules, unrelated pack isolation, and unknown binding typed limitations.
findings.A4_COST_CONTROL_VACUITY: Predecessor test was vacuous without calling projection or comparing actual payload. Corrected by measuring actual payload length A, projected floor P, and admitted budget B, proving A <= P <= B across 5 variations.
findings.A4_REPACK_CONTROL_VACUITY: Predecessor only called planner twice without budget pressure. Corrected by constructing 5000-char budget pressure forcing 4 files to split across multiple chunks with deterministic output across 5 runs.
findings.A5_SHRINK_CONTROL_VACUITY: Predecessor used oversized budget where no shrink occurred. Corrected by establishing budget where full context exceeds budget but required fits, proving optional contracts are dropped while required contracts are retained.
findings.A5_POST_PLAN_BUDGET_MUTATION: Reclassified post-hoc budget reduction as DEFENSIVE_PLAN_BUILDER_MISMATCH_CONTROL. Added canonical flow CM-A5-REQUIRED-FLOOR-EXCEEDS-BUDGET where budget is constrained from the start, yielding degraded non-conclusive plan without post-hoc mutation.
findings.A5_CARRIER_E2E_GAP: Predecessor fabricated intermediate ChunkResults objects. Corrected by executing full carrier graph: intake -> plan -> brief -> payload -> synthetic responses -> parser -> synthesizer -> quality_gate.
findings.QUALIFICATION_ABLATION_GAP: Predecessor lacked causal ablations. Corrected by adding 9 focal causal ablations across A1..A5.
findings.GATE_MANUAL_REVIEW_OVERCLAIM: Corrected universal manual_review_required overclaim: confirmed reliable blockers take precedence (status=degraded, normalized_verdict=changes_requested, manual_review_required=false), while in all cases status != passed.
